summary: Normalize repository issues, reviews, CI work, and pull-request context into private local operational artifacts.

scenarios.title: Capture a repository issue locally
scenarios.prompt: Use $intake-repository-work to capture this requested change and its acceptance criteria in the repository's local operational format.
scenarios.outcome: A provenance-aware local issue and working note that follow existing conventions and remain outside tracked project state.

scenarios.title: Intake a remote review
scenarios.prompt: Use $intake-repository-work to record these pull-request findings locally without replying to or changing the remote pull request.
scenarios.outcome: A new revision-scoped review artifact with exact source freshness and no unauthorized external mutation.
